actions.name: Register on the Cbilling website using either of the following links:
A confirmation link will be sent to your email address. Open the link in the email, then enter the login details provided in that same email.
Then log in to the website using the credentials provided during registration.

name: Activating the trial period and/or purchasing a package

actions.name: After logging in, you'll see that 72 hours of free viewing are available. To activate the 72-hour free trial, click "Get a free trial".
Next, select a package, for example, "PREMIUM IPTV", and click "Get a trial".
When the trial period expires, if you wish to continue watching, return to this step to top up your balance and purchase a package.
To top up your balance, select "Home" in the left-hand menu, then choose "Top up balance" and add funds using your preferred payment method.

After adding funds, make sure the selected package is active, or choose a different package. You will also have access to the Pay-per-view plan, where you are charged only for the time you spend watching. This option is suitable if you don't use IPTV very often.

name: Copying the playlist to your device's media player

actions.name: In your account, select "Home" from the left-hand menu, then choose "Playlist".
In the "Auto-updating playlist with archive" field, click the copy button, or simply select and copy the playlist URL.
Save your playlist URL in a file named link.txt, take a screenshot of it, or save it somewhere else convenient.
Do not share your credentials (key or playlist) with third parties. If simultaneous viewing from different devices is detected, your account will be blocked!
